blocks.text: Prior to the filing of the preliminary plat, the subdivider shall submit to the Planning Commission plans and data showing the subdivider’s ideas and intentions in platting of the property. (Code 1981 § 41-32. Code 1995 § 134-51.)
Cross References: Planning Commission, Chapter 2.225 TMC.
